name: India DPDP Act 2023 and DPDP Rules 2025
obligations: Notice and consent for processing personal data
Data principal rights: access, correction, erasure, grievance redressal
Breach intimation to the Data Protection Board and affected principals
Reasonable security safeguards
Rules 2025 phase obligations in over time; confirm dates with counsel

name: RBI storage of payment system data
hard_effect: zone = india for data-storing components and the payment provider; disaster recovery also in India
obligations: All payment system data stored only in systems in India (RBI circular 2018)
Foreign processing allowed only if data is deleted abroad and returned to India within one business day
Digital lending: borrower data on servers located in India

sources.title: RBI: Storage of Payment System Data (2018)

name: PCI DSS v4.0.1
hard_effect: payment provider must be PCI DSS Level 1; hosting, database and storage providers must list pci_dss
obligations: Use hosted checkout or tokenisation to keep scope near SAQ-A
Never store PAN, CVV or full track data
Quarterly scans, logging and access control

sources.title: PCI Security Standards Council: PCI DSS

exempt_layers.reason: email, SMS and push messages carry no cardholder data, so the sender is outside the cardholder data environment; never put card data in messages

name: HIPAA (US)
hard_effect: every component holding PHI needs a signed BAA; free tiers excluded
obligations: Business Associate Agreement with every vendor that touches PHI
Audit logs and access controls
Encryption in transit and at rest
Minimum necessary use

sources.title: 42 U.S.C. 1320d-8: Processing payment transactions by financial institutions

exempt_layers.reason: processing payment transactions is outside HIPAA business-associate rules (HIPAA section 1179); keep PHI out of payment descriptions and metadata

name: EU GDPR
hard_effect: soft EU preference; vendors need a DPA
obligations: Data processing agreement and SCCs for transfers
DPIA for high-risk processing
Records of processing
Right to erasure and portability

name: SOC 2 Type II
hard_effect: managed vendors must hold a SOC 2 Type II report
obligations: Change management
Periodic access reviews
Centralised logging and monitoring

name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
hard_effect: managed vendors must hold an ISO/IEC 27001 certificate
obligations: Information security management system
Access control and logging
Supplier management
